Concept sheet drawn from the spec note's parts table (tools/blocky/sheet.py); blocky style rules: Blocky-Style.md
Parts (the note's table; mirror x makes an R and an L)
Face plate: `echo` (Secret eye), 56 x 24 px at 32 a stud, 13 frames
Silhouettes at 64 px (black shape, each view in its own frame)
Element: Shadow. VFX: the Cosmic set in shadow (Secret), eight layers in Effects.luau: every 4
s the pipes trill and five violet notes drift from them and fall instead of rising; a deep
violet light breathes on its body; three violet notes orbit over its head; a violet ring rolls
slowly backwards under its hooves every 3.5 s; dark smoke falls at its feet; a held aura of
deep violet glow; and on the flourish it vanishes in a puff of dark smoke and returns under a
violet column of light. The flourish (every 16 s) is that vanish-and-return: a hop, a sink into
the smoke, a full turn, the pipes popping on the trill, the ears flared and the note leaping
